prompt: Use the visualize tool with backend openui, title A3 eleven components. One statement per line, no explanation. Declare these state variables first: $txt = "hello", $area = "two lines", $sel = "a", $seg = "one", $chk = true, $radio = 1, $date = "2026-11-04", $secs = 90, $form = "in form", $icon = 0, $press = 1. Then write exactly one root = statement drawing a Col whose children are, in this order: Input($txt, "Text field"); TextArea($area, "Multi line"); Select($sel, ["a", "b"], "Choose"); SegmentedControl($seg, ["one", "two"]); Checkbox($chk, "Agree"); RadioGroup($radio, [{value: 1, label: "First"}, {value: 2, label: "Second"}], "Pick one"); DatePicker($date, "When"); Timer($secs, "Countdown"); Form([Input($form, "Inside form")]); IconButton("check", @Set($icon, 1), "Icon action"); Pressable([Text("Tap me")], @Set($press, 2), true). Then reply with the single word DRAWN. Do not explain and do not change the content.
